messages:
zara_sales: FYI LargeRetail wants clarity on two things for the on-prem POC in a fully air-gapped datacenter: 1) can we guarantee node-by-node rolling upgrades without cluster downtime, and 2) what does a POC hotfix add-on cost and SLA look like? They also have a question about registry behaviour rewriting content IDs.

ben_se: Short answer: operator supports orchestrated rolling updates, but "no downtime" depends on app topology. If stateful services have a single replica, you'll see brief unavailability during pod restarts. For stateless and replicated services we can avoid visible downtime.

priya_eng: Add detail: our operator performs a sequence: cordon -> drain -> apply new image refs -> wait for readiness -> uncordon. For air-gapped installs we require artifacts to be present in a local registry or node image cache. If DB migrations change schemas and block writers, plan a maintenance window; otherwise live migrations are usually possible if app supports them.

infra_alan: About registry rewriting: if the customer's registry rewrites image IDs (e.g., mirrors that re-calc content digests), delta (patch) bundles that reference exact layer digests can break. We detect that in preflight and either produce a manifest-mapping or fall back to a full bundle. Typical preflight runtime: 10-40 minutes depending on registry size.

zara_sales: Can we commit to a 48h emergency patch SLA for the POC term? They want pricing to include that as an optional add-on.

ben_se: We can offer a POC hotfix add-on: 48-hour triage + build + signed release + remote assist during the POC. Pricing is a fixed monthly surcharge on top of the POC base. I'll send concrete numbers via quote. Note: delta bundles lower transfer size but need consistent layer IDs across nodes. If preflight flags rewriting we bill an additional import verification hourly (small one-off).

priya_eng: Security question about signing/key custody: we produce bundles with detached signatures (OCI/Notary-compatible). For POCs we can sign with Redwood ephemeral keys; for production customers we support BYOK via their KMS/HSM and provide an integration guide. Verification commands for their auditors: 

```
# on the customer's jumpbox after transfer
sha256sum bundle-2026-04-02.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
cosign verify-blob --key redwood_pubkey.pem --signature bundle-2026-04-02.sig bundle-2026-04-02.tar.gz
# import to local registry (nerdctl/ctr depending on env)
nergo copy-into-registry --bundle bundle-2026-04-02.tar.gz --registry registry.local:5000
```

priya_eng: (note) replace the last line with `ctr images import` or `nerdctl load` per their environment. We also provide a short preflight tool that validates import/id stability.

zara_sales: Need a one-paragraph SOW blurb about downtime expectations and upgrade cadence for inclusion in the SOW.

ben_se: SOW blurb suggestion: "Redwood will provide signed offline bundles and an operator to coordinate node-by-node rolling updates in air-gapped environments. High availability requires appropriate replica counts for stateful services; schema-altering database migrations may require a short maintenance window. During the POC, Redwood will deliver monthly security bundles and offers an optional 48-hour emergency hotfix add-on for urgent security or stability patches."

infra_alan: Ops caveats to call out to customer: 1) provide a jumpbox that can receive bundles and reach all cluster nodes or a registry appliance; 2) confirm whether the local registry preserves upstream digests or rewrites them; 3) decide POC signing (Redwood-signed ephemeral vs BYO KMS). Also confirm if they want telemetry opt-in (we recommend on for diagnostics, but can be fully disabled).

zara_sales: I'll draft the mail: SOW blurb, preflight ask (jumpbox + registry behaviour), verification snippet, and a note that hotfix add-on price will be in the quote. Any objections?

priya_eng: None. Also mention we recommend a mirrored staging cluster with identical registry flow so we can validate delta bundles before touching prod.

release-bot: release bundle 2026-04-02-hotfix created by @priya_eng (sha256:fa57c0ffee...); artifacts posted to secure-store for POC delivery.
